verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a cloud email service with a management console, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows SES offers an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Virtual Deliverability Manager's automatic recommendations and the docs' llms.txt/markdown endpoints are adjacent features, not an assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
